AI Engineering Co-op (Summer 2027)
Location: Remote (Canada)

We are looking for a co-op student for a 12-month work term starting May 2027.
Applicants must be currently enrolled in a post-secondary program and graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.

What you'll bring:
- Python and FastAPI
- Experience building with LLMs, RAG and the Claude API or OpenAI API
- PostgreSQL and pgvector
- Docker

Bonus: LangChain, PyTorch
